description_en: Uploads a document to a knowledge base
kebab_example: aliyun dms upload-document --kb-uuid kb-000 --file-name test.md --location knowledge_base/16666986290000/kb-000 --description test --chunk-size 250 --chunk-overlap 50 --separators n --zh-title-enhance false --text-splitter-name ChineseRecursiveTextSplitter --document-loader-name ADBPGLoader --vl-enhance false --splitter-model qwen3-8b --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadDocument

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base
parameters.name: kb_uuid

parameters.help_en: The OSS location of the input file. Construct this path by appending the file name to the `UploadDir` value returned by the `DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature` operation
parameters.help_zh:
输入文件的OSS Location，格式：
DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature接口的UploadDir字段值 + 文件名
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en: The size of each document chunk. The default is 250, and the maximum is 2,048
parameters.help_zh: 要切分的知识块大小。默认值为250，最大值为 2048
parameters.name: chunk_size

parameters.help_en: The number of overlapping characters between adjacent chunks. This value cannot exceed `ChunkSize`. The default is 50
parameters.help_zh: 知识块之间重叠的数据大小。此参数的最大值不能大于 ChunkSize 参数的值，默认值为50
parameters.name: chunk_overlap

parameters.help_en:
An array of strings used to split text.

> - This critical parameter affects data chunking results and is related to the splitter specified by `TextSplitterName`.
>
> - In most cases, you can omit this parameter. The service automatically assigns default separators based on `TextSplitterName`
parameters.help_zh:
用于分割大量数据的分隔符。
> *   这是一个重要的参数，决定了数据分块的效果。此参数与由TextSplitterName参数指定的分隔器相关。
>*  在大多数情况下，您不需要指定此参数。服务器会根据TextSplitterName参数的值来分配分隔符
parameters.name: separators

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable title enhancement
parameters.help_zh: 指定是否启用标题增强
parameters.name: zh_title_enhance

parameters.help_en: The name of the text splitter
parameters.name: text_splitter_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the document loader. The default is `ADBPGLoader`
parameters.help_zh: 文档加载器的名称，默认采用 ADBPGLoader
parameters.name: document_loader_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable visual-linguistic (VL) enhanced content recognition for complex documents. The default is false
parameters.help_zh: 指定是否开启复杂文档的 VL 增强内容识别，默认值为 false
parameters.name: vl_enhance

parameters.help_en: The splitter model to use. The default is `qwen3-8b`
parameters.help_zh: 切分模型，默认值为 qwen3-8b
parameters.name: splitter_model
